title: Canonical quotient page chain maps
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and let $\mathcal F$ be the full category of finite decreasing filtered integer-indexed cochain complexes [def-sp-filtration]. For every $U\in\mathcal F$ and $r\ge1$ fix representative differential data $D(U,r)$ [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential] on the concrete quotients $Q_r^{p,q}=\operatorname{coker}(B_r^{p,p+q}\to Z_r^{p,p+q})$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. There is a unique family of chain maps $m(t,r):D(U,r).\mathrm{page}\to D(V,r).\mathrm{page}$ for filtered maps $t:U\to V$, such that $m(1_U,r)=1$, $m(tt\prime,r)=m(t,r)m(t\prime,r)$, and the following universal square property holds. Whenever step maps $s_a$, a graded map $g:\operatorname{gr}^p U\to\operatorname{gr}^p V$, a cycle map $k_z:Z_r^{p,p+q}(U)\to Z_r^{p,p+q}(V)$ and a quotient map $k:Q_r^{p,q}(U)\to Q_r^{p,q}(V)$ satisfy $s_a\iota^V_a=\iota^U_at$, $\pi^U_{p,p+1}g=s_p\pi^V_{p,p+1}$, $k_z\iota^V_Z=\iota^U_Zg^{p+q}$, and $\pi^U_r k=k_z\pi^V_r$, then $m(t,r)^{p,q}=k$. No successor homology comparison is asserted.

proof.text: Restrict the filtered map to each step, using preservation; uniqueness follows after cancelling the monic step inclusion. Descend to graded pieces by their cokernel property. The pullback and image formulas restrict this graded map to cycles and boundaries, hence give the quotient map.
The epic cover by differential representatives reduces commutation with the differential to the original chain map equation. This gives the chain map on the quotient page.

Cancel monic graded cycle inclusions and epic page projections to prove the universal square property. Identity and composite restrictions supply the category laws, and the existence of canonical squares determines the family uniquely.

theorem filteredQuotient_page_maps
    (D : ∀ (U : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
      (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite)) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r),
      FilteredComplexPageDifferential U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration r) :
    ∃! m : ∀ {U V : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
      (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite)} (t : U ⟶ V)
        (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r), (D U r hr).page ⟶ (D V r hr).page,
      (∀ U r hr, m (𝟙 U) r hr = 𝟙 _) ∧
      (∀ U V W (t : U ⟶ V) (t' : V ⟶ W) r hr,
        m (t ≫ t') r hr = m t r hr ≫ m t' r hr) ∧
      (∀ U V (t : U ⟶ V) r hr,
        FilteredQuotientPageMapProperty (C := C) U V t r (D U r hr) (D V r hr) (m t r hr))
